title: Critical regularity and dissipativity for stochastic reaction-diffusion equations in Bochner spaces over spaces of continuous functions
summary: In this paper, we consider the stochastic reaction-diffusion equation $\mathrm{d}u = (\mathcal{A} u + f(u))\mathrm{d}t + σ(u)\mathrm{d}W$ on a smooth bounded domain $\mathcal{O}$ with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions. We investigate the long-time behavior of solutions with a strongly dissipative drift nonlinearity and superlinear multiplicative noise in the Bochner space $L^q(Ω; C_0(\overline{\mathcal{O}}))$, $q \ge 2$.
